description: Get your posting analytics including stats, streaks, trends, category breakdown, and recent activity. Use type parameter to get specific analytics.

period.description: Time period for tweet analytics (e.g. "7d", "30d", "90d"). Only for type="tweets".

sort_by.description: Sort tweet analytics by metric (e.g. "impressions", "engagement_rate"). Only for type="tweets".

type.description: Type of analytics: "overview" (default, posting stats + streaks + trends), "tweets" (per-tweet engagement), "best_times" (optimal posting hours/days)

x_account_id.description: Filter analytics by X account ID (for multi-account users)

name: opentweet_get_analytics
